title: Confessions II
notes:
Made in Canada.

"Limited Edition" on hype sticker on shrink wrap. Issued in hot pink alternate cover. Record in an inner picture sleeve. Includes a folded poster with album cover graphic on one side and lyrics and credits on the other. Cover with a mirrored tape seal on the pocket opening. Cover interior pocket is hot pink.

Warner Records Inc., a Warner Music Group Company. ©℗ 2026 Boy Toy Inc., under exclusive license to Warner Records Inc.

In the runouts, "315889EⅩ" and "25ⅩⅩⅩⅩⅩ" are machine engraved, "025ⅩⅩⅩⅩⅩ" is laser-etched, and all else is hand etched.

Some copies sold with a Warner Store Exclusive Clear 7” Vinyl of Bring Your Love (feat. Sabrina Carpenter) sealed inside.
